ios.desc:
Discount Calculator is the simplest and fastest app to calculate discounts, sales, track savings, and manage deals on the go.

Take control of your shopping by calculating discounts on any items such as clothing, electronics, groceries, and more. Whether it's a sale, a special offer, or regular purchases, Discount Calculator lets you calculate final prices and taxes easily.

Calculate your discounts and make the most of your savings with Discount Calculator's automatic price calculation. This fast and easy discount & sales calculator is suitable for everyone, making your shopping experience more efficient and cost-effective.

Save your discounts directly in the app. Keep a precise history of your savings for each item, compare prices across different stores, and easily track the best deals. Manage your shopping even more effectively, ensuring you always get the best price.

=== Why should you use Discount Calculator? ===
* Free to use
* No Ads
* Quick and easy
* Calculate discounts
* Save discounts
* Track your savings
* No sign-up or login required

=== DISCOUNT CALCULATOR FEATURES ===
* Calculate discounts and sales
* Include taxes in your calculations
* Save your discounts
* Track your savings on multiple items

=== How to use Discount Calculator: ===
1. Enter the original price of an item
2. Select the discount percentage
3. Add the applicable tax rate (optional)
4. Final price is automatically calculated
5. Save discounts (optional)

Discount Calculator is incredibly simple and fast to use. It's the perfect solution for calculating discounts and tracking your savings without wasting time on complex features. Calculating discounts has never been easier, faster, and more efficient.

Discount Calculator is the easiest and most convenient app to calculate your discounts and sales, so what are you waiting for? Download Discount Calculator now!

***

Thank you for using Discount Calculator. Support us by sharing the app with your loved ones and giving us a 5-star rating on the App Store. Your support will enable us to continue improving the app and provide you with an even better discounts management experience.

quotes.text:
Discounts & Sales Calculator is a very simple app designed to help you calculate discounted prices, with or without tax.

Simply enter the item's price, select the discount percentage, and add the tax if needed. The app will instantly calculate the final price for you.

The app is completely free to use, with no ads, paywalls, or premium features. You also don't need to sign up or log in.

An upcoming update will allow you to save discounts, making it useful for comparing prices at different stores. You'll also have a new tab to view and edit all your saved discounts.

All your suggestions and feedback are welcomed!

Available on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
